heading: Constitution of Benches (Committee of Three Senior-Most Judges)
title: Constitution of Benches (Committee of Three Senior-Most Judges)
text: Every cause, appeal or matter before the Supreme Court shall be heard and disposed of by a Bench constituted by the Committee comprising the Chief Justice of Pakistan and the two next senior-most Judges, in order of seniority.
text_raw: Every cause, appeal or matter before the Supreme Court shall be heard and disposed of by a Bench constituted by the Committee comprising the Chief Justice of Pakistan and the two next senior-most Judges, in order of seniority.

heading: Exercise of Original Jurisdiction under Article 184(3)
title: Exercise of Original Jurisdiction under Article 184(3)
text: Any matter invoking exercise of original jurisdiction under clause (3) of Article 184 of the Constitution shall be first placed before the Committee constituted under section 2 for examination, and if the Committee is of the view that a question of public importance with reference to enforcement of any Fundamental Rights is involved, it shall constitute a Bench of not less than three Judges.

heading: Right of Appeal against orders under Article 184(3)
title: Right of Appeal against orders under Article 184(3)
text: An appeal shall lie within thirty days from an order of a Bench of the Supreme Court exercising jurisdiction under clause (3) of Article 184 of the Constitution to a larger Bench of the Supreme Court, and such appeal shall be heard within a period not exceeding fourteen days.
